programs.name: reward_first
programs.rationale: Ranks direct reward as a transparent reference when conditional TRAIN preferences reverse. Structural reach is root-only; arithmetic is constant-size, but displacement is ignored.

programs.name: reward_per_conflict
programs.rationale: Balances reward against the number of blocked alternatives. Uses local degree with constant-size arithmetic; degree maintenance remains a kernel cost, and unequal neighbor weights are ignored.

programs.name: weighted_capture
programs.rationale: Discounts reward by competing neighborhood weight while retaining reward scale. Uses local aggregate mass without additional traversal; aggregate maintenance costs remain, and mutually conflicting neighbors can exaggerate displacement.

programs.name: strongest_exchange
programs.rationale: Combines normalized margin over the strongest rival with a small neighborhood capture term. Reach is local and arithmetic is constant-size; several jointly feasible rivals can invalidate the single-rival proxy.
programs.rule: (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight) + 0.1 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

programs.name: preserved_residual
programs.rationale: Combines local reward capture, preserved compatible mass, and blocked count fraction using separate weight and count normalizations. Includes coarse global residual context without added scans; compatible mass does not establish mutual feasibility, and aggregate refresh retains its kernel cost.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight) + 0.25 * compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) - 0.1 * degree / (1 + remaining_count)

programs.name: occupancy_efficiency
programs.rationale: Ranks reward per approximate duration-plus-gap occupancy, discounted by the blocked residual fraction. Uses root resource values and degree context with constant-size arithmetic; overlapping gap effects make occupancy only a proxy.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap) * (1 - degree / (1 + remaining_count))

programs.name: density_adaptive
programs.rationale: Continuously shifts from count efficiency toward weighted capture as the root blocks more of the active set. Uses local aggregates and residual size; arithmetic is constant-size, but neither component knows neighborhood topology and base refresh costs remain.
programs.rule: (1 - degree / (1 + remaining_count)) * weight / (1 + degree) + degree / (1 + remaining_count) * weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

programs.name: piecewise_exchange
programs.rationale: Uses direct reward for isolates, exchange margin for single conflicts, and maximum-plus-average penalties for larger neighborhoods. Local count branches provide distinct repair behavior with constant-size arithmetic; missing neighbor compatibility limits the displacement estimate.
programs.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight - max_conflict_weight if degree <= 1 else weight - 0.5 * max_conflict_weight - 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree))
